workstream_a_wait_semantics.lua_script_limitation: WAIT called inside EVAL cannot block; returns immediately without waiting for writes in that script
workstream_a_wait_semantics.connection_affinity_requirement: EVAL and WAIT must execute on the exact same Jedis connection; JedisCluster connection pools break affinity without explicit connection pinning
workstream_a_wait_semantics.replica_ack_vs_durability: WAIT 1 confirms in-memory replication offset only; does NOT guarantee disk fsync on replica
workstream_a_wait_semantics.offset_divergence: Failover must elect highest-offset replica to avoid rollback
